title: Subtree of Another Tree
description: At each node, compare the entire subtree with the candidate. If it does not match, search the left and right subtrees.
note: A match requires identical values and shape, including every descendant. LeetCode supplies nonempty input trees; the recursive search can still reach an empty root.
notes: The root == none guard ends the search at an empty subtree. It narrows root to TreeNode in the remaining body, so root.left and root.right are safe to read.

or tries the current position, then the left subtree, then the right subtree, stopping at the first successful match. A failed comparison at one position does not prevent finding a match deeper in that subtree.

sameTree captures no state, so it is a separate helper below isSubtree in both versions. Each problem is standalone: the helper is included here rather than depending on the separate Same Tree example.
The comparison helper uses the same guard order as Same Tree. It matches two absent nodes, rejects one absent node or different values, then checks corresponding children with short-circuit and.
An empty subRoot is outside LeetCode's input contract. The supplied algorithm returns false in that case; this translation preserves that behavior rather than treating an empty candidate as a match.

For m nodes in root and n nodes in subRoot, the worst-case time is O(m * n) under the usual unit-cost assumptions. The nested search and comparison follow paths inside root, using O(h) recursion space for root height h. Neither input tree is modified.
